responses.en: Hello! Welcome to Sona College of Technology. How can I assist you today?
responses.hi: Namaste! Sona College of Technology mein aapka swagat hai. Main aapki kaise madad kar sakta hoon?
responses.ta: Vanakkam! Sona College of Technology ku ungalai varaverkirom. Naan ungalukku eppadi uthava mudiyum?

responses.en: Sona College of Technology is an autonomous institution located in Salem, Tamil Nadu. We offer a wide range of B.E/B.Tech, M.E/M.Tech, MBA, and MCA programs. We are known for our research excellence (Sona SPEED) and high placement records.
responses.hi: Sona College of Technology Salem, Tamil Nadu mein sthit ek autonomous sansthan hai. Hum kai tarah ke engineering aur management courses offer karte hain.
responses.ta: Sona College of Technology, Salem-il amaindulla oru thannatchi kalloori aakum.

responses.en: We offer B.E/B.Tech in CSE, AI & DS, IT, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, Fashion Tech, and Biomedical Engineering. We also offer MBA, MCA, and Ph.D. programs.
responses.hi: Hum CSE, IT, ECE, Mechanical, Civil, aur Fashion Technology jaise kai engineering courses pradan karte hain.
responses.ta: Naangal CSE, IT, ECE, Mechanical, Civil pontra diverse engineering padippugalai vazhangugirom.

responses.en: Admissions are based on Anna University norms (TNEA counseling) or Management Quota. You can contact our admission cell at +91 9442668758 or email admission@sonatech.ac.in.
responses.hi: Admission TNEA counseling ya Management Quota ke aadhar par hota hai. Adhik jaankari ke liye admission cell se sampark karein.
responses.ta: Serkkai TNEA counseling allathu Management Quota moolam nadaiperum.

responses.en: You can reach us at +91 427 4099999 or email info@sonatech.ac.in. For admissions, call +91 9442668758.
responses.hi: Aap humein +91 427 4099999 par call kar sakte hain ya info@sonatech.ac.in par email kar sakte hain.
responses.ta: Engalai +91 427 4099999 endra ennilon allathu email moolamagavo thodarbu kollalaam.

responses.en: Fee structures vary by course and quota (Government/Management). Please check the 'Admissions' section on our official website or contact the finance office.
responses.hi: Fees course ke anusar alag hoti hai. Kripya website check karein ya office mein sampark karein.
responses.ta: Padippukku etravaru kattanam maarapadum. Dayavuseithu website-ai paarkavum.

responses.en: Sona College has an excellent placement record with top recruiters like TCS, Infosys, Zoho, and Accenture visiting campus. Our highest package often exceeds 10 LPA.
responses.hi: Humara placement record shandaar hai. TCS, Infosys, aur Zoho jaisi badi companiyan yahan aati hain.
responses.ta: Sirappana velai vaippu record-ai naangal kondullom.
